title: State Government's Obligation to Establish a State Consumer Protection Council

content.scenario: The State Government of Gujarat has established a State Consumer Protection Council, but has not specified the effective date of its establishment. A consumer organization challenges the notification in the High Court.
content.outcome: The High Court quashes the notification and directs the State Government of Gujarat to re-issue the notification specifying the effective date of establishment of the State Consumer Protection Council, as required by the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the obligation of the State Government to establish a Consumer Protection Council?
Can a State Government be directed to re-issue a notification?
What is the role of the High Court in ensuring compliance with the Consumer Protection Act?
